units.source_text: 第二天源氏大将送来的慰问信，比平常更加诚恳周全。

en.t: The next day, the letter of consolation sent by General Genji was even more sincere and considerate than usual.

units.source_text: 六条妃子看了不免萦心。

en.t: When Lady Rokujo read it, she could not help being troubled by it.

units.source_text: 然而现在大局已定，不得再有变卦，也只得徒唤奈何。

en.t: Yet now that everything had already been settled, there could be no further change, and she could only lament in vain.

units.source_text: 原来源氏这个人涉及爱情之事，即使对于泛泛之交，也必说得甜甜蜜蜜。

en.t: Genji was by nature a man who, whenever love was involved, would speak with sweetness even to someone with whom he had only a casual connection.

units.source_text: 何况他和六条妃子交情之深，非寻常可比。

en.t: How much more so, then, when the bond between him and Lady Rokujo was so deep that it could not be compared with ordinary ties.

units.source_text: 今当久别，他心中又是惋惜，又是抱歉，懊恨万状。

en.t: Now, facing a long separation, his heart was filled with regret and apology, and he was overwhelmed with remorse.
